verdict.rationale:
Shopify does not expose a llms.txt file (confirmed 404 probe), but it does publish extensive agent-oriented documentation including markdown-native doc pages (e.g. /docs/agents.md returning 200) and a dedicated agents/ doc tree covering catalog, cart, checkout, orders, and profiles for AI agents to consume directly. This is a real but non-standard substitute for the llms.txt convention the story names.
missing for 10: an actual llms.txt (or equivalent well-known discovery file), and independent confirmation that agents can reliably parse/ingest the .md doc tree as a coherent llms.txt-like index.
